context.passage:
From: | [ frontdesk @parkersquarehotel.com |
- LSSL
To: | | rnoro @ mailsail.com |
Subject: | [ re: Early check-in |
Date: | [ May 16, 1:30 PM. |
Dear Mr. Noro,
We received your e-mail about early check-ins. To answer your question, at the Parker
Square Hotel early check-ins are available between 10:00 A.M. and 2:00 PM. for an
additional $25. Guests are requested to contact us at least one day ahead of time so that
we can make arrangements and have a room ready for them in the morning. Because
you'll be arriving tomorrow, could you please reply today by 6:00 P.M. to confirm that you
are interested in checking in earlier?
With best regards,
Lisa Murata
Front Desk Manager, Parker Square Hotel es

尊敬的 Mr. Noro：
我们收到了您关于提前入住的电子邮件。为了回答您的问题，在 Parker Square Hotel，提前入住服务可在上午10:00至下午2:00之间提供，额外收费$25。请客人至少提前一天联系我们，以便我们做好安排并在早上为他们准备好房间。由于您明天到达，能否请您今天下午6点前回复确认您是否有兴趣提早入住？
致以最诚挚的问候，
Lisa Murata
前台经理，Parker Square Hotel es
